text: Create src/orchestrator/memory-retrieval-service.js with getRelevantMemories(agent_id, max_results?, recency_hours?) function implementing relevance ranking based on recency (newer first) and usage frequency (access count decay), returning sorted memories with metadata
Add caching layer to memory-retrieval-service.js using Map-based in-memory cache with configurable TTL (default 60s) to minimize repeated queries during high-frequency dispatch operations
Implement role-based filtering in memory-retrieval-service.js that accepts role parameter and filters memories by agent role using agent-config-store.js to resolve agent roles
Wire memory-retrieval-service.js into dispatch.js replacing direct agentMemoryStore.query() calls with service.getRelevantMemories() for proper relevance ranking and caching at dispatch time
Write unit tests for memory-retrieval-service.test.js covering retrieval logic, relevance ranking (recency and frequency), role-based filtering, cache invalidation, and edge cases
Add performance test to memory-retrieval-service.test.js verifying <50ms retrieval latency under load with 100+ concurrent queries and 1000+ memories per agent
Review memory-retrieval-service.js implementation for correctness, verify relevance ranking algorithm, cache behavior, and integration with dispatch.js
